description: 社会資本情報プラットフォーム(河川-水門) [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大臣官房. 「社会資本情報プラットフォーム」（試行版）では、社会資本の基本情報及び維持管理に関する情報を集計・整理しており、横並びで閲覧・検索を実施することができます。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 大臣官房. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use (compatible with CC-BY-4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
